_comment: Every gutter MarkerSpec key (webview/plugins/headingFold/foldGutter.ts) and the e2e suite whose fixture renders a block of that kind, hovers it, and measures its marker against its own box in the production bundle. gutterContract.test.ts fails when a key in the source is missing here (or an entry here has no key); the named suite fails when a listed key is absent from its fixture or its marker does not reveal or sits outside its block. Add the key here AND to the suite's fixture when a block type gets a MarkerSpec.
